properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1093465 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: HATFIELD & MCCOY DISTILLING CO.
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1093465
Incident Time: 2014-08-22 06:13:00
Nearest City: Gilbert, WV
Location: ON JAMES ST.
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: UNKNOWN MATERIAL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: HATFIELD & MCCOY DISTILLING CO.
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 37.602550, -81.925943 (Approximated from ZIP)
Report Description
THE RESPONSIBLE PARTIES PROPERTY IS CERTAINLY BELOW SAFETY AND SANITARY STANDARDS. THERE IS A VERY STRONG, UNBEARABLE AND UNPLEASANT SMELL IN THE AREA. THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY WAS SEEN PUMPING STUFF OVER THE SIDE OF THE HILL AND IT LOOK LIKE AN OIL SPILL OR WORSE. NOTHING IS GROWING THERE ANYMORE AS FAR AS PLANTS AND GRASS. IT IS TOXIC AND RUNNING DOWN THE HILL INTO A DITCH ALONG THE ROAD AND INTO A STREAM. PEOPLE LIVE NEARBY AND THERE ARE SWARMS OF NATS, MOSQUITOES AND FLY"S ALL OVER. IT LOOKS LIKE AN OPEN DUMPSTER. IT IS UNKNOWN HOW LONG IT HAS BEEN ONGOING. THERE IS STUFF SEEPING OUT OF THE MOUNTAIN FROM UNDERNEATH THE DISTILLERY THAT COULD ALSO CAUSE A POSSIBLE LAND SLIDE. THERE IS SOME TYPE OF SEWAGE THERE TOO. IT IS STRONGLY SUGGESTED THAT THIS IS LOOKED INTO AS AN EMERGENCY.

properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 998439
Incident Time: 2011-12-17 20:15:00
Nearest City: Pensacola, FL
Location: UNKNOWN SHEEN - WEATHER TAR PRODUCT ON BEACH GULF ISLANDS NATIONAL SEASHORE JOHNSON BEACH ROAD DUNE CROSSING F
Incident Type: UNKNOWN SHEEN
Material: CREOSOTE, COAL TAR
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: BP
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 30.329444, -87.377778 (Explicit)
Report Description
LARGE VOLUME (GREATER THAN 2-5% OF SURFACE AREA OF THE WRACK LINE) OF WEATHERED TAR PRODUCT (SURFACE RESIDUAL BALLS (SRB) AND SURFACE RESIDUAL PATTIES (SRP) ASSOCIATED WITH THE HIGH TIDE WRACK LINE CONCENTRATIONS OF SHELL HASH, PEAT, AND BURNED WOOD FROM CAMPFIRES WERE DISCOVERED ON SATURDAY (12/17/11) AFTERNOON AROUND 1500CST. UPON RETURNING AT 2015CST TO CONFIRM THE AREAL EXTENT OF THE WEATHERED TAR PRODUCT DEPOSITS, IT WAS OBSERVED THAT THE LATERAL EXTENT WAS SIGNIFICANT (GREATER THAN 200M) IN ASSOCIATION WITH SHELL HASH DEPOSITS OF THE SAME LENGTH. BACK BEACH DEPOSITS WERE NOT FOUND TO BE SIGNIFICANT AND APPEARED TO BE THE EXPECTED LEVEL OF WEATHERED TAR PRODUCT MATERIAL ASSOCIATED WITH PREVIOUS OBSERVATIONS. THE SIGNIFICANT OBSERVATION WAS THE SIZE OF THE SRP SPECIMENS. THE LARGEST WAS 10CM X 6CMX 4CM (LWD). THE AVERAGE SIZE WAS 5CM X 3CM X 1CM. ALL OF THE SRP/SRB SPECIMENS EXHIBITED CHARACTERISTIC FLUORESCENT RESPONSE OF 550-630NM WHEN ILLUMINATED BY 365NM UV LIGHT SOURCE INDICATING THE PRESENCE OF DISPERSANT MIXED WITH THE CRUDE OIL PRODUCT AND SUBSEQUENT SURFACE WEATHERING. LOCATED 200M EAST OF DUNE WALKOVER RAMP F (FOXTROT).

Location: BEHIND A WAREHOUSE IN A BUSINESS PARK NORTH OF THE CITYS DOWNTOWN
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: PROPANE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 36.160043, -86.777644 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Report Description
A FIRE AT A LARGE PROPANE TANK HAS BURNED ITSELF OUT IN NASHVILLE. REPORTED THE FLAMES WENT OUT AROUND 8 A.M., ABOUT TWO HOURS AFTER IT ERUPTED BEHIND A WAREHOUSE IN A BUSINESS PARK NORTH OF THE CITY'S DOWNTOWN. THERE WERE NO INJURIES, BUT A FORKLIFT NEAR THE TANK WAS DESTROYED. AN EMPLOYEE OF THE WAREHOUSE TOLD THE TV STATION 10-15 PEOPLE WERE IN THE BUILDING WHEN SOMEONE SAID THERE WAS A FIRE AT THE TANK THAT CONTAINED FUEL FOR THE FORKLIFTS. EVERYONE GOT OUT SAFELY AND FIRE OFFICIALS SEALED NEARBY BUSINESSES AND CLOSED A ROAD FOR A TIME. MOST FIRE EQUIPMENT WAS MOVED BACK, BUT ONE ENGINE REMAINED, CONTINUOUSLY DOUSING THE TANK WITH WATER UNTIL THE FIRE EVENTUALLY WENT OUT.
